notes: Two of the phrase's three *the*s are supplied on construct nouns; only the bracketed article token before *Korahites* is a written article (rules 12, 15, 29).
מַחְלְקוֹת is absolute, not construct, so its supplied *the* joins the noun under rule 15 rather than rule 29.
Marginal cross-references to Shelemiah and Ebiasaph were read and set aside under rule 38.
